rationale: Raw count-derived levels are systematically miscalibrated against direct references. The commission explicitly permits adaptive TRAIN/DEV model reformulation and direct+struct combination. Test whether a TRAIN-only affine calibration preserves useful structural variation.

structural_state.chronology: For target block B use complete source state from blocks strictly < B, max age 24h.
structural_state.senate_scalar: T50=P(R seats>=50); T51 excluded because semantics unresolved.

calibration.fit: On TRAIN only, ordinary least squares target_current = a + b*struct_scalar.

direct_plus_struct.fit: On TRAIN only, zero-intercept beta for next_target_change = beta*gap_t.
direct_plus_struct.baseline: direct_target_t persistence to literal next target update.

metrics: calibrated contemporaneous MAE vs previous-direct persistence
next-update MAE/RMSE improvement vs direct persistence

candidate_requires: QP and KL next-update MAE improvement >0
QP and KL both DEV halves >=0
